sections.title: TypeScript checking rules
sections.what: Sets how strictly TypeScript checks code, which JavaScript version it targets, the at-sign shortcut for the src folder, and which files it checks. It skips node_modules, one folder named Auto-Check-claude-enhance-github-profile-mavOF, and a folder named frontend.
sections.why: Strict checking catches many mistakes early. Reason for the skipped folders is not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Code inside the skipped folders is never type-checked.

summary: Sets how strictly TypeScript checks the code and which files it looks at.
purpose: Tells the TypeScript compiler the rules for checking code and the shortcut for importing from the src folder.
why: Strict checking catches many mistakes before the site is run. Reason for the excluded folders is not stated in the code.
how: Sets the target version, strict checking, the JSX mode Next.js needs, and the at-sign shortcut for src. Then it lists the files to include and the folders to skip.
inputs: Read by TypeScript and Next.js during builds and by the editor.
outputs: Type errors reported during checking. No compiled output is written because noEmit is on.
risks: Folders listed under exclude are not checked at all. Errors in them go unnoticed.
debug: If a type error appears, read the file and line it names. If a file is never checked, confirm it is not in the excluded folders.
